requirements.title: The application shall persist all state under the single localStorage key "summit.habits.v1" as a JSON document with schemaVersion 1 and a habits array

vision.paraphrase: One namespaced, versioned key holds a schemaVersion plus a habits array with the documented fields.

conops.paraphrase: Archiving is observable in storage as the archived flag with completions untouched.

requirements.title: The application shall write state to localStorage immediately upon every mutation, with no save button or delay

vision.paraphrase: Every mutation serializes and writes immediately — no save button, no debounce.

conops.paraphrase: The moment a check-in happens, it is already saved — persistence is never a separate act.

requirements.title: The application shall hydrate its state from localStorage on boot so that habits, streaks, archived flags, and today's check-ins all survive a reload

vision.paraphrase: Goal G5: all state lives in localStorage and survives reload/restart.

conops.paraphrase: The reload in the first-run scenario proves habit, streak, and check state all persist.

requirements.title: The application shall start cleanly with an empty state and no error when the storage key is absent

vision.paraphrase: A fresh browser is a normal first run, not an error condition.

conops.paraphrase: First-time boot shows the friendly no-habits-yet state, not a failure.

requirements.title: The application shall surface unreadable saved data with an in-page banner that names the problem and offers a "Start fresh" action, rather than silently showing an empty list

vision.paraphrase: Unreadable saved data is a first-class state: a banner names the problem and offers Start fresh, never a silent empty app.

conops.paraphrase: The recovery path keeps the user in control of their raw data instead of discarding it.

requirements.title: The application shall treat a stored schemaVersion it does not understand as unreadable data and show the same recovery banner

vision.paraphrase: schemaVersion exists so future releases can migrate — v1 must never silently rewrite a future-shaped document.

conops.paraphrase: Forward-compatibility failure lands on the same explicit recovery path as corruption.

requirements.title: The application shall reset to a clean empty state when the user chooses "Start fresh"

vision.paraphrase: Start fresh is the user-initiated recovery action promised by the banner.

conops.paraphrase: Recovery ends in the familiar empty state, ready to begin again.
